exposure: Mode of delivery (planned cesarean section vs. planned vaginal delivery)
cohort: 1,655 women with a very preterm delivery of a twin pregnancy (26-32 weeks of gestation)
finding: In very preterm delivery of twins, a vaginal delivery is the preferred mode of delivery, as it is associated with lower perinatal mortality, perinatal morbidity, and maternal morbidity compared to planned cesarean section.
mod_finding: In very preterm delivery of twins, vaginal delivery was associated with lower perinatal mortality and morbidity compared to planned cesarean section.
